title: Build a PHP chatbot in 10 minutes
content:
<html><head></head><body>The chatbot topic is huge right now. Finally, there is something quite new again, and nobody knows what's happening next. This is the perfect chance to start experimenting with chatbots and to build your own one right now. Give me 10 minutes of your time, and I will give you your first chatbot!
            </body></html>
